Understanding Your Property Taxes
It's that time of year when counties have to try to explain the differences between mills and dollars, county tax and school/city/park/everything else taxes, etc. NDACo worked with several auditors some years ago to come up with an explanation and sample calculation that seems to make some sense of this challenging topic.
Follow www.ndaco.org/propertytax .
